description: Look up a drug by name or product. Resolves a query string to matching DrugBank drugs/products and their DrugBank IDs. Example: drugbank_drug_names({ query: "lipitor", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: DrugBank API key (commercial; trial keys at dev.drugbank.com).

query.description: Drug or product name to search for, e.g. "lipitor", "atorvastatin".

name: drugbank_drug_names
title: Drugbank Drug Names
